data: Week-one essentials for engineers joining Squad Atlas (Payments) at Meridian — on-call, compliance, releases, data handling, architecture, ownership, and secrets.
Which tool does Squad Atlas use to run its on-call rotation and paging?
Atlas runs its on-call rotation through Opsgenie; keep the Opsgenie app installed before your first shift (Squad Atlas — On-Call Runbook).
When an Opsgenie alert pages the Atlas primary on-call engineer, what is the acknowledgement SLA before it escalates?
Alerts route to the primary on-call with a 10-minute acknowledgement SLA; miss it and Opsgenie escalates to the secondary, then the squad lead (Squad Atlas — On-Call Runbook).
On Squad Atlas, a failed payment settlement is classified as which incident severity?

Severity is set by impact to money movement, not alert volume. A failed settlement means money movement is impacted, so it is always Sev1 — never downgrade it to Sev2 because 'only a few payments' failed (Squad Atlas — On-Call Runbook).
Because Atlas handles cardholder data directly, which compliance regime does the squad operate under?

As the highest-volume card processor at Meridian, Atlas operates under PCI-DSS Level 1 — the strictest tier. Treat it as the baseline behind every design decision (Squad Atlas — Compliance & Data Handling).
How is card data classified under Meridian's data tiers, as applied by Atlas?

Card data is Tier 0 (Restricted), Meridian's highest tier: it may never be logged, never appear in error messages, and never leave a PCI-scope service boundary (Squad Atlas — Compliance & Data Handling).
How does Atlas handle the Primary Account Number (PAN) in its storage?
Encrypted with AES-256 in the ledger
Tokenized at rest — a raw PAN is never persisted
Stored in a dedicated PAN vault table

The PAN is tokenized at rest: the tokenization service exchanges it for a token at the edge, and only the token flows through Rail into Atlas datastores. A raw PAN anywhere is a Tier 0 incident — page on-call (Squad Atlas — Compliance & Data Handling).
What is Squad Atlas's production deploy policy regarding timing?
Deploys allowed any day with approval
No deploys on Friday or over the weekend
A deploy freeze only during month-end settlement

Atlas does not deploy on Friday or over the weekend — the pipeline is gated to refuse production releases Friday through Sunday. Genuine emergencies use the incident-change path with on-call lead plus Priya sign-off (Squad Atlas — Release & Change Policy).
Which check must pass before any Atlas pull request can merge?

The ledger-reconciliation contract test must be green before merge — it verifies recorded entries match settled balances. A red result blocks merge with no override (Squad Atlas — Release & Change Policy).
How many approvals does a production change to atlas-ledger-svc require?
Every production change requires dual approval — two engineers — and one of them must have real context on the area changed; a rubber-stamp doesn't count (Squad Atlas — Release & Change Policy).
What is the primary datastore behind atlas-ledger-svc?

The primary datastore is Aurora PostgreSQL, with the ledger modeled append-only — rows are never updated or deleted in place, so full payment history is reconstructable for reconciliation and audit (Squad Atlas — Architecture & Datastores).
What is the name of Squad Atlas's primary service and repository?

atlas-ledger-svc is the primary service and repo — it holds the ledger, settlement workers, and reconciliation logic, and is where new hires spend most of their time (Squad Atlas — Charter & Ownership; Architecture & Datastores).
What is the internal codename for Atlas's payment-initiation API?

The payment-initiation API is internally called Rail. 'Submit it to Rail' means the entry point on atlas-ledger-svc that accepts a payment instruction and hands it to the ledger (Squad Atlas — Charter & Ownership; Architecture & Datastores).
Who is the squad lead and engineering manager of Squad Atlas?
Priya Nair is the squad lead and EM, and the escalation point for ownership disputes and payment-path commitments. New hires should book a week-one 1:1 with her (Squad Atlas — Charter & Ownership).
Where does Squad Atlas store all of its secrets?
In Vault, under a per-squad `atlas/` namespace
Encrypted .env files committed to the repo

All Atlas secrets live in Vault under the dedicated per-squad namespace `atlas/`. Nothing belonging to Atlas is stored outside it, and services read from `atlas/` at runtime rather than copying secrets into code (Squad Atlas — Secrets & Access).
What customer-facing SLA does Atlas publish for payment status availability?

Atlas publishes a customer-facing SLA of 99.95% monthly for payment status availability — customers must be able to see a payment's state every calendar month. Breaching it triggers a customer-facing comms review (Squad Atlas — Charter & Ownership).
